item.title: ‘PERFECT,’ CVANCARA BACK IN THE GOAL ROUTINE

item.title: WATCH AGAIN: THE DEADLY DOUBLE AS CHAMPS STAY ON COURSE
item.description: CELTIC made no mistake as they attempted to make up ground on Premiership pacesetters Hearts with their 2-0 victory over a vastly-improved Falkirk side at Parkhead yesterday. item.title: CELTIC REJECT £17m ENGELS BID
item.description: CELTIC have knocked back a £17million bid for Arne Engels from Nottingham Forest. Martin O’Neill was delighted with the rejection of the offer for the Belgian playmaker and insisted the board may have been tempted at £100million! item.description: DON ROBERTSON will be in charge of Celtic’s crucial Premiership encounter against Aberdeen at Pittodrie on Wednesday. item.title: CELTIC v HIBS SWITCH
item.description: CELTIC’S Premiership encounter with Hibs at Parkhead has been switched to Sunday February 22 with a 3pm kick-off. item.description: JOHNNY KENNY has swapped chasing the Premiership title with Celtic for aiming at promotion at Bolton.
